name: Danger Sense (Combat)
body:
You have learned to trust your gut, even against unseen foes.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): When attacked by an unseen opponent you may make a Perception check with a DC equal to your opponent’s attack roll, if you succeed you do not lose your dexterity bonus to AC against that opponent until the end of your next turn, though they still gain a +2 to attack rolls against you for being unseen as you do not reveal their location.
